description: Six independent delays of a few audio samples each, for lining signals up frame by frame rather than for anything audible

params.text: Sets how many samples row A is delayed by, 1 to 32
Sets how many samples row B is delayed by, 1 to 32
Sets how many samples row C is delayed by, 1 to 32
Sets how many samples row D is delayed by, 1 to 32
Sets how many samples row E is delayed by, 1 to 32
Sets how many samples row F is delayed by, 1 to 32

inputs.text: The signal to delay on row A; it takes as many channels as you give it, up to sixteen
The signal to delay on row B; it takes as many channels as you give it, up to sixteen
The signal to delay on row C; it takes as many channels as you give it, up to sixteen
The signal to delay on row D; it takes as many channels as you give it, up to sixteen
The signal to delay on row E; it takes as many channels as you give it, up to sixteen
The signal to delay on row F; it takes as many channels as you give it, up to sixteen

outputs.text: Row A's signal, delayed, with the same number of channels as went in
Row B's signal, delayed, with the same number of channels as went in
Row C's signal, delayed, with the same number of channels as went in
Row D's signal, delayed, with the same number of channels as went in
Row E's signal, delayed, with the same number of channels as went in
Row F's signal, delayed, with the same number of channels as went in

notes: a delay of one sample at 44.1kHz is about 0.02ms, far too short to hear; the module is for timing, not for echo
every module a signal passes through delays it by at least one sample, which is what these rows are for undoing
